summary: The guide page strictly complies with the assigned plan, word count target (2,001 words vs 2,000 target), and scope boundaries. Sourced citations from the ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance on documenting and reviewing nonconformities as well as NIST RPD-G-08 are accurately quoted and contextually integrated. All four subsections thoroughly address workflow decisions, inputs, roles, records, exceptions, and verification criteria. Each section features a consistently labeled hypothetical illustrative example following the unnamed machining manufacturer scenario without claiming unverified vendor features or customer outcomes. No unassigned FAQ section is present.
